tasks.subject: Task 1: wok_rc non-destructive peek (C + FFI)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add a general `wok_rc` returning a cell's refcount without modifying it, with a non-destructive C unit test, plus the Haskell FFI binding.

**Files:** runtime/wok_rc.h, runtime/wok_rc.c, runtime/test/wok_rc_test.c, src/Wok/Interp/RC/Heap.hs

**Verify:** bash scripts/asan-runtime.sh && cabal build

```json:metadata
{"files": ["runtime/wok_rc.h", "runtime/wok_rc.c", "runtime/test/wok_rc_test.c", "src/Wok/Interp/RC/Heap.hs"], "verifyCommand": "bash scripts/asan-runtime.sh && cabal build", "acceptanceCriteria": ["wok_rc returns p->rc non-destructively", "works on NCon and WokArray cells", "asan-runtime.sh prints OK sanitizer-clean", "cabal build succeeds with wokRc exported"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```
